snippet.title: NES Longplay [397] Swords and Serpents
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: JagOfTroy

One, if not the only game in existence that is a dungeon-crawling RPG which allows four-players to have simulateous control at the same time. It is a no-holds barred advenutre through sixteen floors of hell in order to slay the gruesome serpent which awaits at the end. It was developed by Interplay, being one of its earlier creations and seven years before the release of the first Fallout game in the series.
NOTE:Unfortunately, there wasn't anything that could be done to save the ending as it glitched out no matter what I tried. Trust me, the ending wasn't worth all the time it took to longplay this anyways. It had a strobbing effect and less words than the end screen in 'GHOSTBUSTERS'. No cutscene, nothing. -
